scope: Final Step 1 mirror and canonical review, ten separated critics, accepted finding repair, regression, final judge, exact seal, activation/completion evidence and live read-back.

reviewBase.message: docs: freeze Round 008 final preseal content

previewEvidence.readyMeaning: documentation Preview build evidence only; not quality PASS

severity.P0: Unauthorized destructive/public/provider/Production change, loss of historical evidence, executable legacy promotion, or product contract defect that can create unrecoverable economic or legal harm.
severity.P1: Contradictory or missing current authority, unresolved stable-ID/state/dependency gap, invalid evidence ancestry/digest binding, or any defect that prevents a truthful Step 1 seal or Step 2 implementation without guessing.
severity.P2: Nonblocking later-step implementation or release item whose owner, blocking condition and verification point are explicit.
severity.P3: Editorial or optional clarity improvement with no semantic or gate impact.

requirements.requirement: All writes use existing kimi explicitly; no branch, PR, merge, rebase, cherry-pick or force push.
The ten critics are separate artifacts and review the same exact semantic content commit/tree or an explicitly recorded repaired successor.
requirements.failure: A critic reviews an unspecified or mixed content state.

requirements.requirement: All accepted P0/P1 findings are repaired before final judge; repair changes create a new frozen content commit/tree and all affected critics are rerun against it.
requirements.failure: The judge ignores or silently defers a P0/P1.

requirements.requirement: Stable IDs, cross-file references and state-machine dependencies are exact; no persistent ID is invented only in a lower document.
requirements.failure: Any canonical write/reference cannot be resolved or violates instance normalization.

requirements.requirement: Current-authority finite-100F/no-gacha/Dawn/two-currency/nine-screen/local-only/3,000-scenario assertions are zero; all tracked paths and new Route 01-4 paths are classified.
requirements.failure: Any current assertion, unclassified path or unclassified match remains.

requirements.requirement: Historical Acceptance/PASS/audit/deployment evidence remains byte-unchanged and is not used to authorize the current product.
requirements.failure: Historical evidence is rewritten or promoted.

requirements.requirement: The matching kimi Preview is READY, target is Preview/null, commit and branch match, and Production aliases/domains are not changed.
requirements.failure: Deployment mismatch or Production alias operation occurs.

requirements.requirement: Final judge reports unresolved P0=0 and P1=0, exact reviewed content/evidence commit/tree, changed paths, forbidden paths, Preview binding and physical iPhone NOT_VERIFIED.
requirements.failure: Any required field is absent or unsupported.

requirements.requirement: The seal binds exact semantic content paths and blob/digest evidence, critic summary, final postcheck, final judge and Preview; Vercel READY alone is insufficient.
requirements.failure: Seal inputs are ambiguous, stale or self-asserted without read-back.

requirements.requirement: A direct-descendant activation/completion commit updates active mirrors to Step 1 PASS and Step 2 READY_TO_START without creating V2 artifacts; a later live read-back confirms HEAD/tree/status/seal.
requirements.failure: Status is advanced before a valid seal, V2 work starts, or live read-back does not match.

requirements.requirement: Runtime, assets, V1 candidate/schema/validator/simulator, workflow YAML, backend, payment provider and ad network remain unchanged.
requirements.failure: Any forbidden implementation or provider path changes.

requirements.requirement: Physical iPhone remains NOT_VERIFIED and no runtime, economic simulation, payment, ad or device quality PASS is inferred from Step 1 documentation.

allowed: Route 01-4 acceptance, critic, judge, postcheck, deployment, seal and completion evidence

commitSequence: accepted finding repair and new frozen content when needed
affected critic rerun and critic summary
final repository postcheck and final judge evidence
passCondition: Every requirement passes, unresolved P0/P1 are zero, exact evidence ancestry is valid, forbidden changes are zero, and live read-back confirms the activated seal. Otherwise Step 1 remains IN_PROGRESS and Step 2 remains BLOCKED.
